summary: Allegro Merger Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting mutual termination of its merger agreement with SeeQC, Inc. and SEEQC Merger Sub, effective August 25, 2026. The de-SPAC merger, originally agreed January 16, 2026, would have made Allegro a wholly-owned subsidiary of SeeQC. Termination permits parties to pursue other transactions prior to the original October 31, 2026 outside date. Under the Settlement, Termination and Release Agreement, SeeQC will pay Allegro up to $2 million of documented expenses and issue $6 million in SeeQC stock at a $1.3 billion pre-money valuation if a Trigger Event occurs. Claims are released with retained exceptions. What to watch: Allegro's ability to find an alternative de-SPAC target before its liquidation deadline, and whether SeeQC's Trigger Event materializes to deliver the contingent consideration.
